title: Ivano-Frankivsk Raion
summary: Ivano-Frankivsk Raion is a district located in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast, Ukraine, established in July 2020 as part of administrative reform. The district's center is the city of Ivano-Frankivsk and it has a population of approximately 556,104 as of 2022.

sections.heading: Creation and Administrative Reform
paragraphs: Ivano-Frankivsk Raion was formed in July 2020, following a significant reform of the administrative divisions within [[ukraine|Ukraine]]. This reform aimed to streamline local governance and improve administrative efficiency.

sections.heading: Geographical and Demographic Information
paragraphs: The raion is situated in [[ivano-frankivsk-oblast|Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast]], with the city of [[ivano-frankivsk|Ivano-Frankivsk]] serving as its administrative center. As of 2022, the estimated population of Ivano-Frankivsk Raion is 556,104.

sections.heading: Subdivisions and Hromadas
paragraphs: Upon its establishment, Ivano-Frankivsk Raion included 20 hromadas, which are local administrative units. These hromadas were formed from the merger of five previously existing raions: Bohorodchany, [[halych|Halych]], [[rohatyn|Rohatyn]], Tlumach, and [[tysmenytsia|Tysmenytsia]], along with Ivano-Frankivsk and Burshtyn Municipalities.

The hromadas within the raion include Bilshivtsi, Bohorodchany, Bukachivtsi, Burshtyn, Dubivtsi, Dzvyniach, Halych, Ivano-Frankivsk, Lysets, Obertyn, Olesha, Rohatyn, Solotvyn, Stari Bohorodchany, Tlumach, Tysmenytsia, Uhryniv, Yamnytsia, Yezupil, and Zahvizdia.
